name: OBV Trend

changelog.description: On-Balance Volume trend signal with EMA directional gate. Thesis: OBV captures smart-money accumulation/distribution before price moves; EMA alignment confirms direction. Replaces Pairs Trading (incompatible with single-asset architecture). Modeled on 151-strategies volume-flow section.

backtest_90d.verdict: DISABLED — unprofitable, highest trade count (149) but worst WR (28.2%). OBV signal too noisy as primary indicator without stronger trend filter.

description: OBV-primary trend passport. OBV > EMA(20) = buying pressure (LONG), OBV < EMA(20) = selling pressure (SHORT). EMA trend confirms direction. No RSI/MACD dilution.
